objective: Test whether Exp202 failed because Prefix64 was too weak despite accurate QLL localization.
single_causal_change: The QLL-selected source is fully excluded instead of exposing its first 64 tokens.
frozen_from_exp202: TopiOCQA normal development IDs and gold answers

policy.source_locator: frozen Qwen query likelihood over each retrieved source
policy.locator_probability: softmax of four mean query-token log probabilities
policy.threshold_rule: strict greater than the frozen Exp202 threshold
policy.backfill: deterministic equal water-filling over the remaining retrieved sources
policy.nontrigger_behavior: balanced top-4 context with the same 2048-token budget

cache_policy.reuse: only exact generator, revision, system-prompt hash, prompt hash, decoding config, and output budget

expansion_rule: Only if every Phase-B gate passes, open session ledger, native six-attack, and RAGLeak evaluation in a separate frozen experiment.
claim_boundary: This is a reused development-cohort causal test. It is not a fresh blind, domain-general, or complete multi-attack result.
